subtitle: Bread, tiella di Gaeta, pizzette and holiday sweets. Three generations, one oven, the same shop facing the sea.

story.title: Since 1922, in the same shop
story.text: Almerindo De Conca came back from America and on 4 April 1922 opened this bakery with his wife Annunziata, on the corner of Salita Porta di Terra. Three generations have kneaded here since: Almerindo, his children (the "De Conca brothers") and today Alessandro. In 2022 the town of Gaeta celebrated our first hundred years with us.

photo.alt: Old black-and-white photo: the bakers at work in the bakehouse
photo.caption: At work in the bakehouse, [[YEAR]]

order.title: Order today, collect tomorrow
order.text: Calzoncini, potato frittatine, focaccine, tielle and pizzette are baked in quantities decided the day before: call +39 0771 460651 by [[ORA_LIMITE]] and they'll be ready at the time you ask for; walk in without ordering and you'll get them if any are left. Whole tielle, cakes, maritozzi and gift baskets need [[ANTICIPO]] notice. No forms, no apps: the shop answers.
